history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-23, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#702, #625). Five arms at track-p f8725bc0 (everything ships off there, so ctl is today's play): ctl; light (cave_light_engine_radius 1); belief (unseen_belief 1); light+belief; light+belief-decay5 (light+belief with unseen_decay_percent 5, the owner's choice to measure the decay apart). Pilot as the gate, then the full tier (classes-1800 starts 901-1800, 900 per arm), matching #695 and #702's other arms. Comparisons: each arm against ctl; light+belief against light; light+belief-decay5 against light+belief, paired by start (exact McNemar). Wanted: per game the '# Unseen target (#879):' notes (pilot, retained evidence) and how many hit; the known waste of #889 ('It dies.' not attributed). The light arm also pairs with #702's light at 206cf4e7 only descriptively (different build).
Tier pilot: classes-18, 100,000 turns, one binary, shipped settings plus each arm's overrides, borg-rs core, 100,000 turns, specimen track-p f8725bc0. Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every
cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; identical plays per arm (belief alone is expected to change little: C's light radius deletes the records first). Report per arm and class: deaths and causes, rescued and newly killed against ctl (exact McNemar), CL and
depth, alive at the cap having reached DL5; tiers of one study pooled (RULES 14). Descriptive. Switching either setting on in harness/borg.txt is a borg-reborn-rs P8 decision on this run.
